title: Timing of Chargeback Dispute Evidence and the Dispute Response Fee, Northloop Payments
content:
How soon after the chargeback debit a seller submitted the dispute that was won scales the base response fee withheld from the debit returned on that Northloop Payments case.

**Rule.** The base response fee is scaled by an evidence timing multiplier of 0.5 when the dispute was submitted no more than 2 calendar days after the chargeback debit date, 0.75 when it was submitted 3 to 5 calendar days after, and 1 when it was submitted later.

The days are the calendar days from the date of the chargeback debit booked on the case to the date the won dispute was submitted.

## Ladder

| Calendar days from the chargeback debit date to the submission of the won dispute | Evidence timing multiplier |
|---|---|
| 0 to 2 | 0.5 |
| 3 to 5 | 0.75 |
| 6 or more | 1 |

## Boundary cases (hypothetical, chargeback debited on day D)

| Won dispute submitted on | Multiplier |
|---|---|
| D plus 2 | 0.5 |
| D plus 3 | 0.75 |
| D plus 5 | 0.75 |
| D plus 6 | 1 |
